sources.title: Qwen3 Complete Guide: Every Model from 0.6B to 235B
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the best open model family for budget local AI. Dense models from 0.6B to 32B, MoE models that punch above their weight, and a /think toggle no one else has.

sources.title: Best Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Models in 2026: More Knowledge, Less Compute
sources.snippet: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are the reason AI got cheap in 2026. They pack hundreds of billions of parameters (knowledge) into a model that only activates a fraction per token (compute).
